stories.title: UK and EU seal post-Brexit 'reset' deal at Brussels summit
stories.summary: The UK and EU concluded a reset deal covering a youth mobility scheme allowing 100,000 young people to live, work and study in each direction, closer agrifood trade rules and linked carbon markets. The divisive question of equal tuition fees for EU students in Britain was deferred to talks over the next six months.

stories.title: Global stocks head for longest losing streak since 2023 as AI trade unravels
stories.summary: A gauge of global equities fell for a seventh straight session, the longest run since 2023, with Anthropic dropping more than 7% Friday after its record IPO and chipmakers extending a 35% slide from their June peak. Gold fell below $3,600 as investors sought safety in bonds.

stories.title: Nike signs long-term deal to become Formula 1's official apparel partner
stories.summary: Formula 1 announced a long-term global partnership with Nike, making it the series' official apparel and uniform supplier from 2027, replacing Puma, with support for the all-female F1 ACADEMY. A limited Nike x Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule collection launches Friday during the Vegas race weekend.

stories.title: US national cyber director Sean Cairncross stepping down
stories.summary: White House national cyber director Sean Cairncross is leaving the post, Axios reported, in an amicable split timed so a Senate-confirmed successor can be seated before Democrats take control of Congress in January. The departure comes amid a flurry of unexplained technical outages reported by US businesses.

stories.title: Anthropic's record IPO: key takeaways and what's next for AI
stories.summary: The Claude maker's $81.3 billion IPO, the largest on record, priced at $83 and closed Thursday up 17% at $97.17, valuing Anthropic around $1.5 trillion. The historic debut failed to steady AI stocks, and shares slipped further in early Friday trading.

stories.title: Anthropic's seven founders cashed out nearly $2B in record IPO
stories.summary: The seven co-founders sold roughly $2 billion of stock in the Claude maker's record-breaking listing, TechCrunch reports. The IPO minted thousands of employee millionaires, while early backer Dustin Moskovitz said he felt uneasy about the windfall.

stories.title: Sayin out again as Ohio State heads to Nebraska; Fahey set for third straight start
stories.summary: Ohio State's Thursday availability report lists quarterback Julian Sayin among seven Buckeyes ruled out for Saturday's game at Nebraska, meaning freshman Luke Fahey starts a third straight game. At 7-3 and No. 14 in the CFP rankings, Ohio State likely needs to win out, starting noon ET Saturday on FOX.

stories.title: Grid penalties stack up after rain-hit opening day in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli's new internal combustion engine earns the Mercedes rookie a five-place grid drop for Sunday's race, adding to penalties already confirmed for Piastri, Sainz, Bearman and Stroll. Teams wrote off Thursday's wet sessions as offering little useful data with dry conditions forecast for Friday's running.

stories.title: Red Bull working to fix Verstappen's balance issues after tricky Vegas practice
stories.summary: Max Verstappen managed only 13th in a damp FP2, reporting balance and energy-management problems as Red Bull's technical director admitted the team has work to do ahead of Friday practice and qualifying. Team mate Isack Hadjar was a more encouraging fourth.

stories.title: Russell tops wet second practice in Las Vegas; FP1 washout yields no lap times
stories.summary: George Russell set the pace in a rain-affected FP2 with a late 1:47.272, 0.071s clear of Alpine's Pierre Gasly, after the opening session produced no timed laps at all. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc was third as the track never fully dried.

stories.title: Sainz handed 10-place grid penalty for Las Vegas GP after turbo change
stories.summary: Williams fitted a fifth turbocharger to Carlos Sainz's car, exceeding his season allocation and triggering a 10-place grid drop. Oscar Piastri also faces 10 places lost for a new engine, while George Russell opted against Mercedes' upgraded turbo to avoid a penalty of his own.

stories.title: Blue Jackets to host 'Hockey Tonk' country night Nov. 25 vs. Devils
stories.summary: The Columbus Blue Jackets announced a 'Hockey Tonk' themed night at Nationwide Arena for their Nov. 25 game against New Jersey, featuring live country music, mechanical bull rides and a country anthem performance from BELLES.

stories.title: Sunny, mild weekend ahead for central Ohio before Sunday-night rain
stories.summary: Friday hits 67 under sunny skies with Saturday near 65, before a cold front brings scattered light rain Sunday night and a much cooler week. Highs drop to 49 Monday, with a chance of rain or snow showers returning by Thursday.
